nom: Patchology Serve Chilled On Ice Cooling & Firming Under Eye Gel Patches

segments.dry: A reviewer identifying as a 'dry skin girl' says these patches hydrate the under-eye area noticeably.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe themselves as sensitive to fragrance report the perfume in the patches is strong enough to bother them and to linger after cleansing; one with an eye area that 'gets irritated a lot' says the cold patches feel soothing rather than irritating.
segments.mature: A 68-year-old reviewer reports the cold patches are soothing and help with puffiness and brightness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report the patches make the eye area look firmer, plumper, and younger-looking, and one notes reduced fine lines after one use, though the same reviewer saw no change in dark circles.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including one who calls herself a 'dry skin girl,' report visibly more hydrated, softer, plumper under-eye skin, some noting results in as little as 5 minutes.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the patches took away a 'hot red look,' and another says the formula evened out red cheeks and nose to match the rest of the face.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report lightened or less noticeable dark circles, but at least two say they saw hydration benefits with no real change in dark circles.

aspects.libelle: Patches slide or slip out of place

extraits.texte: I bought two sets as the reviews were promising, but the fragrance on them was a very heavy perfume scent. It was way to much for me. I removed them within minutes and even after a double cleanse, the scent lingered on my skin. I have no idea if they work well. Tossed the 2nd pair. Beware if you are sensitive to fragrance.

extraits.titre: Cooling felt great, scent was too strong
extraits.texte: The cooling sensation was refreshing, however I could not keep the patches in place. They would slide down my face constantly unless I laid down. The scent was not my favorite but I am very sensitive to fragrences.

I used these eye patches one time and was impressed by how it reduced my fine lines and gave me a hydrated appearance with just one use, however there was not much of a change in my dark circles. I had to lay down while using thrm otherwise they wouldve kept sliding down my face.

I recently tried all of the available patches, and these are my favorite! I keep them in the refrigerator, so when I use them they are ice cold and feel so good on my skin. My eyes and the area around it gets irritated a lot and I put these on, and my eyes feel like icy bliss! Along with the great ingredients of peptides and bakuchiol. Makes my eyes look and feel icy firm!

extraits.titre: Wish these also came in a 30 pair set
extraits.texte: These are nice and cooling and help wake me up in the morning. The formula has noticeably helped with the dark circles under my eyes. It also tones my skin, so my red cheeks and nose change color to match the rest of my face. I'm just disappointed that the On Ice eye gels are not available yet in a 30 pair set. I love these. So I'll be patiently waiting for the day a 30 pair set of Served Chilled On Ice set is available. Here or at Ulta Beauty.

I love the Serve Chilled on Ice eye gels because my under eye area gets really puffy and these do an amazing job at de-puffing my under eye area. They also help to hydrate my under eye area, which as a dry skin girl, I really appreciate. As per usual for patchology products, these sit on my under eye area nicely and don't slip, so I am able to do other things while the eye patches are at work!
I am 68 years old. These cold patches (I keep in fridge) are soothing under my eyes, and do help with puffiness and brighten up the skin.
